Jacketed Hollow Point ammunition, or JHP, is designed with a cavity in the center and usually frangible. Upon striking its target, it will "blossom" into petals and fragment. This causes a parachute-like effect and slows it, lowering the chances that it will pass through the target and strike an unintended surface or person. The blunt nose design reduces any "missile" effect FMJ may have.

Fragmentation and expansion also has the added bonus of causing more tissue damage and can generate more effective stopping power, since the target will be dealing with multiple bleeds over a larger area. Any fragments that make it through the target will have less damaging potential and breaking up the round minimizes ricocheting.
